issue: Blame language — pointing at the other person
impact: Immediately puts the other person on the defensive and kills collaboration.
suggestion: Try: 'I felt frustrated when this happened. Can we figure out a solution together?'

impact: Signals low accountability — reduces trust with managers and peers.
suggestion: Try: 'I underestimated what was needed. Here is what I will do differently.'

impact: Sounds irresponsible without a plan — leaves the listener with no confidence.
suggestion: Try: 'The workload was heavier than expected. I should have flagged it earlier. Here is my plan.'

impact: Signals you do not respect deadlines or the other person's concerns.
suggestion: Try: 'I understand this is urgent. I will have it done by [specific time].'

impact: Shuts down dialogue — the other party stops listening and gets defensive.
suggestion: Try: 'I see it differently. Can I share my perspective calmly?'

impact: Signals low confidence or disengagement — the other person loses trust in you.
suggestion: Try: 'Let me think about this and come back with a clear answer by [time].'

impact: Comes across as hostile — makes productive conversation impossible.
suggestion: Try: 'I would like to pause this and revisit it when we are both calm.'

impact: Sarcasm signals contempt and immediately breaks trust.
suggestion: Try: 'I have some concerns about this approach. Can we talk through them?'

impact: Closes the door on finding a solution — the situation stays unresolved.
suggestion: Try: 'I hear you. Let us focus on what we can do to fix this going forward.'

impact: One-word answers signal disengagement and give the other person nothing to work with.
suggestion: Try: Give a complete sentence that acknowledges the concern and offers something constructive.

impact: Calling out interruptions mid-conversation increases tension rather than resolving it.
suggestion: Try: 'I would appreciate a chance to finish my thought — then I would love to hear yours.'

impact: Ultimatums destroy trust and rarely lead to a good outcome for either side.
suggestion: Try: 'I am feeling very frustrated. Can we find a time to discuss this properly with HR or a mediator?'
